notes.title: An update to optimize the character's skills
notes.notes: Dandelion's evasion can now collide with enemy attacks and counterattack. Cinder King's ground basic attacks can now collide with enemy attacks and counterattack. At the same time, Embers King's block counterattack is easier to achieve.

notes.title: super powerful characters to choose from!
notes.notes:
Your enemies won't show mercy, and you'd better treat them the same way. Start your personal battle journey!
Dandelion - an upright and kind-hearted star race who guards the border between humans and demons, but a catastrophe completely changed her behavior...
The King of Embers - the king who killed countless cruel and cruel kings, who grew up after merging with the sword of embers, she can't tell whether she is a demon or a sword.
All grass, gods and trees - a bit special, the developer has always wanted to try to make a character that uses only 5 buttons for complex operations, which is shown in the Q version style. She herself has a strong talent and strength of the Protoss, but she can't use more abilities on the earth with insufficient magic power...
